content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm encountering an issue with two counters used to update on/off values for a threshold trigger, operated via the arrow keys on the [product_name] display interface. While testing in simulation mode, everything works as expected. However, during live operation, the 'CNT' parameter doesn't visually update in the parameter box, even though viewing the counter in online mode shows its value changing. Due to this, I'm unable to adjust the threshold trigger values directly via the interface. For reference, the analogue threshold trigger reads a pt100 sensor and this is part of a heating control setup.

Welcome to the forum, [user_name]. If you can see the counter value changing in online watch mode, then the system itself is operating correctly. The current value of the counter just isn't shown online at the ON or OFF parameter of the threshold trigger.

Thank you for the clarification. I've checked it online and confirmed that the trigger points do change. I was initially confused as I didn't realize parameter values aren't updated live in the box. Appreciate the assistance—likely not my last question!

analysis.insight_summary: Users observed that counter values update properly when monitoring online, but the parameter fields on the interface do not show real-time changes. This creates confusion as users expect the graphical interface to reflect immediate updates for objects like threshold triggers when adjusting parameters.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the parameter fields for counters and triggers within the interface will update instantly to mirror real-time data during online monitoring sessions.
